settings.title: The Flavors
settings.lede: Three real-fruit ideas. Three tall slim cans. All under 50 calories with just 9g of sugar.

settings.name:
Green
Apple
settings.description: Granny Smith on the front, tart snap in the middle, clean finish that never goes sticky. Think first-bite-of-a-cold-apple energy in a can.

settings.name: Mojito
settings.description: Cold lime, fresh mint, the kind of fizz that wakes you up. We took the cocktail apart, kept the breezy half, and put it in a can.

settings.name:
Water-
melon
settings.description: Ripe, juicy, summer-on-a-porch. We dialed in the sweet without crossing into candy. Tastes like the slice you went back for.
